issues.detail: Hebrew has 'Mirma' (מִרְמָה) as the third name, but Vietnamese has 'Mích-ma' which appears to be a different name (possibly a confusion with Michma/Micma). The correct transliteration should be 'Mích-ma' for Mirma? Actually 'Mích-ma' is closer to 'Michma' (מִכְמָס) or 'Micma', not 'Mirma'. The Hebrew name is Mirma, so the Vietnamese 'Mích-ma' is a name swap/mistransliteration.
